mcp_environment.harness: Claude Code CLI, two separate sessions in tmux over SSH
mcp_environment.processes: two live RoslynMcpServer processes; each parent is a separate claude process; each was launched by the owner's launcher ~/.local/share/roslyn-mcp/launch.sh
mcp_environment.method: Read /proc/<pid>/environ. Values hashed with SHA-256 in memory and compared between the two processes. No values or hashes are stored.
mcp_environment.note: CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR and PWD differ because the two sessions run in different checkouts (main repo and worktree). The other names differ per harness session or per terminal/login session.
